scope: Source-page and metadata inspection, prerequisite closure and original instructional cases. HTTP availability is not video playback or clinical validation.

Cyber orientation Scratch/AI mismatch replaced; binary/encoding chapters retained only in the maths bridge with exact bounds.
All three studios now display per-resource viewing/reading scope, optional extensions, bounded start/end excerpts and stable source completion identities.
Voice orientation uses short W3C input/output demonstrations; neural/backpropagation/attention teaching now has focused visual explanations with long CMU material optional.
Introductory HMM/state-sequence/Viterbi material now precedes connected-speech/training overviews. Detailed source-filter mechanics follow the filter lesson.
Child OT assignments now identify specific NHS modules. CDC school-age scope and redirected sleep-resource attribution are corrected.
Narrow webinars, decoder-only talks and historical API material are labelled as limited/optional coverage, not complete teaching of unrelated topics.

Follow-up review adds 43 focused video assignments and narrows one existing recording across 31 formerly reading-led/optional-only topics plus two topics with thin illustrative coverage. Every new assignment has a verified running time, named unit and lesson-specific scope; longer sources use bounded excerpts.

Content follow-up distinguishes complete transcript evidence, exact-video teaching-material evidence and description-only matches for all 44 reviewed assignments. R03 is narrowed to 41:30–48:13; ASHA MLE components, historical rating/cut-off context and Rasa example attribution are clarified.

Transcript follow-up replaces fifteen description-only recordings, verifies one existing optional talk from its archived transcript and retains one unresolved ASR-evaluation assignment. Historical audits are preserved; replacement recordings use new completion keys.

Remaining-transcript follow-up reads the 20 teaching-material-only assignments and V25: thirteen originals retained, eight assignments replaced with fresh completion keys. Excerpt starts/stops, historical claims, commercial affiliation and clinical/technical scope are corrected. All 44 current audited assignments now have scoped transcript evidence.
limitations: No complete playback/caption audit of every external video.
Some sources block automated requests or require provider accounts; access notes and alternative original lessons/readings remain visible.
Clinical competence and individual treatment suitability are not assessed; cases are fictional and formal training/supervision are separate.
Hosted storage isolation/merge checks and callback configuration were verified on 30 October 2026; fresh OAuth/email/recovery and actual two-device sign-in remain untested.

Second-review public-page audit checked 189 distinct existing source/video URLs plus selected additions. HTTP 403/406/timeouts are unresolved access checks, not proof a source is missing. YouTube title/uploader metadata was checked; full playback/captions were not.

This follow-up checked all 566 distinct baseline assignment URLs and inspected public publisher/video metadata, available transcripts and PDF/slide identities. Not every complete recording/caption track or every claim in an external textbook was independently validated. Some sources impose browser/account checks; no CAPTCHA was bypassed.

Video-gap follow-up verifies source identity, published content descriptions/available transcripts, durations and chapter markers. It does not claim complete playback/caption validation; videos may cover a named component while the native lesson/readings cover remaining objectives.
The content-review manifest records per-assignment evidence and unresolved speech checks. Companion slides/outlines and available caption metadata are not treated as verbatim transcript review.

All 44 current assignments in this audit have transcript-reviewed evidence, covering assigned passages or complete clips when assigned in full. Automatic-caption errors and historical/visual limits are explicit. This is not a transcript audit of every video in the full three curricula.
